services.desc: These cabins sleep up to four people and include one queen bed and one single bunk Cabin 3 is our biggest cabin and sleeps up to 8 people. It includes one queen bed and three bunks. It is a two room cabin. These cabins are one room cabins and sleep up to six people. They include one queen bunk and two twin beds in a loft. The Potting Shed is our most popular cabin! It features two rooms, one for sleeping and a separate kitchen area. It sleeps up to four people and has one queen bed & one single

services.name: Campground Activities
services.desc: Our 8ft deep pool is well maintained and perfect cool down on a hot day. The pool is open from mid-June to September 15th for all campers. Non-campers may also use the pool for $3/person/day or purchase a season pass for $50/family The rec. room includes a TV with basic cable and the ability to connect to Netflix and other movie services, a blue-ray DVD player, ping-pong, retro arcade games, & tables. This is a community space and is first come first serve. Feel free to eat dinner in here on a rainy night or watch the Red Sox! Take a peak at our unique gifts & souvenirs featuring the Bass Harbor Head
